title: Skincare Routine for Combination Skin: One Simple Morning and Night Plan
ex: One simple morning and night skincare routine for combination skin, how to choose a face cream for both zones, and how to use a brightening cream well.
rt: Skincare Routine for Combination Skin | Mirc Glow
rd: A simple skincare routine for combination skin: morning and night steps, how to choose a face cream for both zones, and how to use a brightening cream safely.
quick: Use one routine with zone-based amounts: gentle gel cleanser, light moisturiser (more on the cheeks, less on the T-zone) and sunscreen in the morning; at night, cleanse, use one active a few nights a week, and apply a medium-weight cream the same way.
facts: Combination skin is oily on the T-zone and normal or dry on the cheeks.
Niacinamide suits both oily and dry areas.
Brightening creams work best at night with morning sunscreen.
Expect 8–12 weeks for a more even-looking tone.
